deployment-ops-edho-ferdian.description: Agent form of the deployment-ops-edho-ferdian skill, same triggers — delegate here when the task justifies isolated or parallel execution; a small task should use the skill directly instead. Getting a build to production and keeping it healthy — release strategy (rolling / blue-green / canary), CI/CD pipeline gates, health checks and Kubernetes probes, environment config and rollback, a production-readiness ship/block verdict, operator dashboards, and post-deploy watching. Starts where container-ops-edho-ferdian stops (image built, compose working).
